comparison_policy.captured_tensors: exact source storage bytes; exporter performs no attention arithmetic
comparison_policy.compressed_kv_and_indices: source layer-two _compress_kv borrowed layer-one publication; layer two has no Indexer
comparison_policy.layer_one_published_kv_and_indices: exact current layer-one ratio-two owner publication used by source layer-two _compress_kv
comparison_policy.output_bf16: exact Attention.forward output after source inverse RoPE and output projections
comparison_policy.prepared_window_kv_bf16: source _window_kv newly published value; decode is the just-written ring slot
comparison_policy.q_after_rope_bf16: exact sparse_attn query operand after source RoPE
comparison_policy.sparse_output_pre_inverse_rope_bf16: exact sparse_attn result cloned before source inverse RoPE
comparison_policy.window_kv_and_ring_bf16: source _window_kv returned read and cache snapshot after its write

attention.frequency_scope: full layer-two source freqs_cis schedule captured from the module prehook; exact complex64 real/imaginary FP32 storage pairs, not recomputed per-case slices
attention.scope: layer-two source attention boundaries, including source-prepared local and layer-one-published compressed KV; not native attention, Rust acceptance, or full-model parity

comparison_policy.hc_coefficients: source records retained for fixed source-derived envelope checks

ffn.scope: layer-two source FFN tail from captured post-attention residual to the layer-three Engram stream and block incoming pre-mix; not layer-two attention, layer-one shared-compression production, full-model parity, or serving

hc.scope: source layer-one output into layer-two attention HC bridge; not native attention or full forward parity

scope: source alternate layer-two HC, attention, and FFN-tail operands for the observed 4/1/1/1 partition; not canonical capture metadata or native execution
